name: consumer_failure_policy

test_list.description: Every consumer has an explicit failure mode; safety, PII, postflight and strict arbitration never fail open.
Timeouts and malformed decisions produce degradation without invented answers.
Repeated transport failures stop admission until a trusted host reports worker readiness.
An in-flight result from a retired worker is discarded after host recovery.
A valid high-confidence answer cannot bypass calibration.
Bounded admission rejects excess work and releases its permit when canceled.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Host-selected policy identity and bounded masked input.

output_description: Validated answers and threshold verdicts, or explicit failure mode and sanitized reason.
